customer: Lost the title to my pickup somewhere between the baby stuff. I'm in Corlan and want to sell it to you. What do I do?
agent: Congrats on the new baby! Per our article "Getting a duplicate title in Corlan," you'll need a duplicate title application signed by every owner on the title and notarized, then mailed or taken to a Corlan motor vehicle office. Duplicates take 2 to 3 weeks, but you can get an offer and book an appointment with us while you wait. If one of the owners can't sign, check our article "When more than one person owns the car."
